items.title: Flat Friends sections
items.precondition: Signed in and open /friends with no incoming requests.
steps: Inspect the page at desktop width.
Compare the loaded and loading states with the supplied screenshot.
Confirm the header does not repeat the Friends-section count.
items.expected: The page uses exactly one quiet, Messages-style card with no padded outer canvas, nested add-request strip background, Friends-only pronounced shadow, or redundant mutual-count header chip.
items.evidence: 2026-08-07: User confirmed the final browser visual check after Rev 6. Friends has one Messages-style card, no outer canvas or nested strip surface, and no redundant mutual-count header chip.

items.title: Compact, accessible empty states
items.precondition: Signed in; first with no incoming requests, then with no mutual friends.
steps: Open /friends at desktop width and 375px width.
Inspect the Friend Requests and Friends empty states.
items.expected: Each state retains its icon, heading, description, and any action slot in a compact, left-aligned status row that does not dominate the vertical page area.
items.evidence: 2026-08-07: User confirmed the final browser visual check. Empty states are compact status rows and remain readable in the tested UI.

items.title: Existing Friends actions remain intact
items.precondition: Signed in with fixtures or accounts covering a request, an outgoing request, and a mutual friend.
steps: Confirm or decline an incoming request and cancel an outgoing request.
Use search and Escape to close it, open a message, and open then cancel the unfriend dialog.
items.expected: Every existing action, error treatment, focus behavior, and navigation path behaves as before.
items.evidence: 2026-08-07: User confirmed the implemented Friends changes were tested, covering the existing Friends flows.

items.title: Frontend verification gates
items.expected: All commands succeed. Any execution-caused failure is corrected before finalization.
items.evidence: 2026-08-07: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck, npm --prefix frontend run build, and npm --prefix frontend run lint passed after the Rev 6 refinement. The build emitted only Vite's chunk-size advisory.
items.notes: Lint emitted six pre-existing warnings outside the Friends files. npm run check:conventions -- --strict is unavailable because the repository does not define that script.
